card.name: Reference lists and file-link listings
card.fires_on: Punctuation, numbers and word pieces inside academic citations and web download listings, such as journal volume and page numbers or '(Acrobat (PDF) 22kB'. Mostly in non-drug science and course web pages.

modes.label: Download link details
modes.description: Parts of a file-type and size note on a course page, like PDF, Acrobat and the date.

modes.label: Citation details
modes.description: Commas, years and page numbers inside journal references.

modes.label: Abstract listing headers
modes.description: Colon after the word Abstract in dated paper listings.
modes.example: Dec 01, 2011; Abstract<<:>> An integrated in situ monazite laser

card.plain: It fires on the small details of references and file-download lines on science and course web pages.
